## Purpose
`/workflows/activities`: the Activity Gallery. It lists activities (all and pending), synthesises one as a background run, and bulk-deletes. It also exports `toolPurpose`.

## Responsibilities
- **`toolPurpose(tool)`** decides whether a Tool Service record is an activity or an agent tool.
- **`ActivityGalleryPage`:**
  - reads `toolsApi.list` and `pending`, filtered to activities;
  - tabs;
  - `ToolCard`s;
  - the Synthesize dialog with `useSynthesisRun("activity")`, and the toast "Activity “<name>” …";
  - bulk delete over the visible tab.
- Titled "Activity Gallery — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`ActivityGalleryPage`, `toolPurpose`.

## Control flow
React Query plus a background run.

## Data, state and side effects
Synthesis runs and deletions.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **`toolPurpose` is reused** by the tools pages and components.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The visible tab's list is what can be selected and deleted.**
- **The background run behaviour is the same as on `/tools`.**
